body:
## The position

Bright Futures Recruitment is seeking a committed, resilient cover supervisor to join a fantastic SEMH school in a small village just outside Colchester. It's an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about supporting young people with social, emotional and mental health needs.

## About the school

- Caters for up to 80 boys aged 10 to 16 with a range of SEMH needs.
- A safe, nurturing and supportive environment.
- A flexible curriculum tailored to each pupil.
- Access to therapeutic interventions when required.
- Focused on helping pupils achieve socially and academically, without limits.
- Rated Good by Ofsted (2024).

## The role

- Supervise classes during teacher absence.
- Support pupils with SEMH needs in their learning.
- Maintain a positive, calm and safe learning environment.
- Build rapport and set clear boundaries.
- Work as part of a dedicated, supportive staff team.

## What you'll need

- Strong behaviour management skills.
- Confidence working with young people with SEMH needs.
- Reliability, resilience and a caring approach.
- Availability for an immediate start.
summary: A resilient cover supervisor is needed at an Ofsted Good SEMH school for boys aged 10 to 16.
title: Cover Supervisor, SEMH School
